Field notebook checklist

Prepare the notebook before leaving the workshop. Each step gives the next reader enough context to repeat a measurement, find the original instrument and understand any change made during the visit.

  1. Write the station name and the observation date at the top of each page.
  2. Record the instrument identifier and compare its reading with the reference sample.
  3. Attach the inspection checklist and describe anything unusual.

Pack these items

  • A pencil and spare labels for wet weather.
  • A clean sample bottle and a record of its previous use.
    • Keep the bottle sealed until the sampling point is ready.
  • The previous report, so changes can be checked against actual observations.
